item.description: - Fixed a crash that could happen after updating an app, or a moment after checking for Apple Silicon versions

- Update Intel apps right from the list: an Update button next to every app with an Apple Silicon version or an update, and Update All… for all of them at once - Homebrew apps install with brew; apps with their own update feed download, are checked against the developer's signatures, and replace the old copy, which goes to the Trash - App Store apps open their store page - When Homebrew needs your password, Finish Update in Terminal does the rest - After an update, the list and the log show what the app is now: Universal or Apple Silicon

- Find Apple Silicon versions of your Intel-only apps (⇧⌘U): SiliconScope asks Homebrew, the app's own update feed and the App Store, and shows the download page or the `brew install --cask` command - CrossOver launchers for Windows programs are recognised and labelled instead of being counted as Mac apps to replace - New Log page with every scan and check, filterable by level and source - Settings: extra folders to scan, which sources to ask, check after every scan, auto-refreshing processes, appearance - A Help window with ten topics, and a complete Help menu - SiliconScope now updates itself
